review.title: Nhận xét bài viết trên lớp
paragraphs: There is an opinion that the news media have too much influence on people's lives today and this is a negative problem. Personally, I am of the same school of thought but not all.

Admittedly, one might of argue that the news media have too much influence on people lives today. This is predicated initially on the assumption that in modern life today, the widespread access to smartphones and the Internet, these technologies allow people to follow the news instantly wherever and whenever they are, so checking news become a regular part of their routine. and the intense competition among news outlets lead to gain attention, most media agencies focus on breaking content and present it in a highly sensationalized manner with dramatic headline and eye-catching visuals, so that it make people reinforce the overall impact of news on public opinion.

However, I strongly believe that beside the negative influence on people lives today, the news media can having many good effects to our lives. The news media expose to a constant stream of distressing and exaggerated news and make overwhelmed people feel overly anxious, helpless and even in situations that do not directly affect them. However, the news coverage warn the public to existing and looming problems in society, crime, natural disasters, or political corruption. We can see the natural disaster about Yagi flood in Vietnam two years ago, the news media was always up the new information about it. Its movements [chưa đọc rõ] to people in the area location [chưa đọc rõ] on TV and save many people lives. This very instance clearly suggests how the news has many good effects in people lives today. It help individuals have better information and more prepared to respond to potential threats so that we can handle risks in an increasingly complex society.

In conclusion, I am personally convinced that the news media have too much influence on people lives today but it not sure a negative development because it have many good effects on people lives today.

completion.comment: Cô đã đối chiếu đủ trang gốc: bài có mở bài, hai đoạn thân bài và kết bài.

review.overall: Em có đủ ý và ví dụ Yagi riêng khá cụ thể, gồm địa điểm, thời gian, truyền hình và tác dụng cảnh báo; Cô giữ phần đó. Tuy nhiên, bài còn nhiều lỗi cấu trúc lặp lại và khâu tự soát chưa kỹ: can having, expose thiếu tân ngữ, competition lead to gain và It help. Em cần viết lại với chủ thể rõ ở từng bước và bỏ mượn lời ở luận điểm chính. Phần chữ mờ trong ví dụ được giữ ở bản gốc, chỉ có gợi ý diễn đạt, không quy thành lỗi của em.

paragraphs: There is an opinion that news reporting exerts an excessive influence on people's lives today and that this trend is harmful. Personally, I agree that this influence is considerable, although I do not consider it entirely negative.

Admittedly, the news media exert a considerable influence on people's lives today. Initially, in modern life, the widespread access to smartphones and the Internet allows people to use these technologies to follow the news instantly wherever and whenever they are; consequently, checking news becomes a regular part of their routine. Furthermore, the intense competition among news outlets encourages most media agencies to seek attention by focusing on breaking content and presenting it in a highly sensationalized manner with dramatic headlines and eye-catching visuals, thereby reinforcing the overall impact of news on public opinion.

However, I strongly believe that besides their negative influence on people's lives today, the news media can have many good effects on our lives. The news media expose people to a constant stream of distressing and exaggerated news and make them feel overwhelmed, overly anxious and helpless, even in situations that do not directly affect them. However, the news coverage warns the public to existing and looming problems in society, such as crime, natural disasters, or political corruption. We can see this in the natural disaster of the Yagi flood in Vietnam two years ago, when the news media were constantly providing new information about it. Updates about its movements were broadcast to people in the area on television, helping save many people's lives. This very instance clearly suggests how the news has many good effects on people's lives today. It helps individuals have better information and be more prepared to respond to potential threats, enabling them to handle risks in an increasingly complex society.

In conclusion, I am personally convinced that news media exert a considerable influence on people's lives today, although this is not an entirely negative development, as news reporting has many good effects on people's lives.
